review_description: Can definitely recommend Sun Gods Solar. Glenn was on the phone the next day to discuss our system and was only to happy to visit our property. We ended up going with a larger system than first anticipated as we had the room and the price was competitive. Installation was booked in for the following week and all went smoothly. The install team were professional, friendly and provided a great looking setup. Follow up visit from Ryan to run through the docs etc was again professional and helpful. We are now just waiting for the grid connection.

The whole process was easy, response from suppliers was quick and simple. We eventually chose Sun Gods Solar as they were easy to deal with and great value for money, professional in their approach and tidy and efficient with the installation.Am very happy with our decision and want to also than Finn for the initial assistance and providing 3 quotes from reputable operators.

Glenn from Sun Gods solar was very helpful from the start, he suggested a larger system and we are very happy that we went that way. Any queries were attended to in a fast and efficient manner.The installers were courteous and were able to answer any questions I had.

Our experience was positive from the initial telephone call, meeting at our home and the installation of the system. We will recommend Glenn and his team to our best friends and clients ( we don’t have family in AUS)We are very happy with the system, work and service

Sun Gods Solar was prompt with quoting and had good followup and availability for questions. Installation was completed with the system performing to the level they advised. I've been very happy with their service and followup during the whole process.
All of the suppliers that quoted were good but Sun Gods Solar provided excellent service and the best price
I was told twice they would attend after installation, both times they failed to show
Glenn and his team did a great job. Installed on the day we arranged.

Of the 3 quotes Sun gods replied same day, SAE 5 days later and then confused the appointment times twice, Hawkings solar finally contacted me for a quote a week after it had already been installed.Sun gods were clearly miles ahead on service and price, they also did my neighbours place too and he had the same experience.

I have had an inssue with the inverter (Sungrow) as it derates or shutdown on a frequent basis. Sungods solar have been out twice to investigate and are now looking to replace on warranty. Communication with Sungrow (in Sydney) is a bonus. It is due to be changed as per last correspondence but that to date is yet to be done. So far service and call back is good, waiting on the next stage. I have a 10 year warranty on the inverter also.

Very professional and easy to deal with. What appealed to me from the start that supply and installation was quick and done by the same company and so is the warranty and the product and installation. Small company but very efficient!!And communication and follow up was excellent from the first contact to finish.

Everything was explained to me in a way that I was able to understand instead of using technical terms that would've meant nothing to me. Everyone  was very professional and friendly.I'd highly recommend them.

Although I got the system early July, I received a bill mid August. no mention of solar being installed no feed in no difference to bill. all agencies say someone else lost paperwork or didn't follow through. hopeful all will clear up in due course. hard to tell if it's been worth until then

Brought a Fronius. Jinko package off these guys, great value, Adam was great, his boss wasn't,  forgot his name!!!! Pretty good system no problems, yet fingers crossed! The boss has no customer service.

Suns Gods Solar Air Conditioning and Electrical changed the original contract/quote by supplying a different inverter 2 days after I accepted the quote. (eg the change went from Sungrow to Growatt.)  The day of the installation of the Sungrow the inverter would not come on line for the installer. A replacement Sungrow was installed after 2 days. It too has a problem in that it (the inverter) drops out for no reason. After contacting the supplier I was informed firstly it must have been some cloud cover. This to me was a palm off as it was Friday afternoon and the supplier had been paid in full. I monitored the system for the next three days with the same result of drop outs. On contacting the supplier again three days later I was informed to contact  David, the Growatt representative and explain the situation.David has asked me to take a photograph of the inverter display when this problem occurs again and email it to him. So  now my weekend is spoken for waiting for this intermittent fault to occur.
